cues: A plant hormone is an organic substance made in small amounts in one part of a plant, and carried to another part, where it controls some process.
Plants have no glands and no nerves.
Hormones are their entire long-distance messaging system.
text: A plant hormone is an organic substance made in small amounts in one part of a plant, and carried to another part, where it controls some process. Plants have no glands and no nerves. Hormones are their entire long-distance messaging system. There are five classical ones.
